addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# run_m2_full_starcoder_resume.sh — Resume 8 remaining runs
#
# random_s42 已完成 (step 4200/4242, checkpoints saved)
#   best_by_val_loss:    /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder/random_s42/best_by_val_loss/
#   best_by_recall_at_1: /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder/random_s42/best_by_recall_at_1/
#
# D026: s42 = 3 epochs, s43/s44 = 2 epochs
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

PROJECT_ROOT="/root/structfuse"
MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/bigcode/starcoder2-3b/bigcode/starcoder2-3b"
STARCODER_DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data"
CHECKPOINT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder"
LOG_BASE="/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "============================================"
echo " StarCoder M2 Resume: 8 remaining runs"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo " GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
echo "============================================"

# (strategy, seed, epochs)
RUNS=(
    "random:43:2"
    "random:44:2"
    "embedding_distance:42:3"
    "embedding_distance:43:2"
    "embedding_distance:44:2"
    "dataflow_aware:42:3"
    "dataflow_aware:43:2"
    "dataflow_aware:44:2"
)

mkdir -p "$LOG_BASE"

for run_spec in "${RUNS[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r strategy seed epochs <<< "$run_spec"
    RUN_NAME="${strategy}_s${seed}"
    OUTPUT_DIR="${CHECKPOINT_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}"
    TRAIN_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
    VAL_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
    RUN_LOG="${LOG_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}.log"

    echo ""
    echo "── Training: ${RUN_NAME} (${epochs} epochs) ──"
    echo "  Output: $OUTPUT_DIR"
    echo "  Log: $RUN_LOG"

    mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$(dirname "$RUN_LOG")"

    EXTRA_ARGS=""
    if [ "$strategy" = "dataflow_aware" ] && [ -f "${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json" ]; then
        EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
    fi

    python -u "${PROJECT_ROOT}/training/train.py" \
        --model-name "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --train-file "$TRAIN_FILE" \
        --val-file "$VAL_FILE" \
        --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
        --hard-negative-strategy "$strategy" \
        --seed "$seed" \
        --batch-size 8 \
        --num-negatives 7 \
        --max-seq-length 2048 \
        --num-epochs "$epochs" \
        --learning-rate 2e-5 \
        --temperature 0.07 \
        --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
        --eval-steps 500 \
        --save-steps 1000 \
        --use-lora \
        --gradient-checkpointing \
        --wandb-project structfuse \
        --wandb-run-name "m2_full_sc2_${RUN_NAME}" \
        --early-stopping-patience 2 \
        $EXTRA_ARGS \
        2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"

    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${RUN_NAME}"

    if [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}/best" ]; then
        find "${OUTPUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " ALL 8 RESUME RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"

addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# run_m2_full_starcoder_resume.sh — Resume 8 remaining runs
#
# random_s42 已完成 (step 4200/4242, checkpoints saved)
#   best_by_val_loss:    /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder/random_s42/best_by_val_loss/
#   best_by_recall_at_1: /root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder/random_s42/best_by_recall_at_1/
#
# D026: s42 = 3 epochs, s43/s44 = 2 epochs
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

PROJECT_ROOT="/root/structfuse"
MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/bigcode/starcoder2-3b/bigcode/starcoder2-3b"
STARCODER_DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data"
CHECKPOINT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder"
LOG_BASE="/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "============================================"
echo " StarCoder M2 Resume: 8 remaining runs"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo " GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
echo "============================================"

# (strategy, seed, epochs)
RUNS=(
    "random:43:2"
    "random:44:2"
    "embedding_distance:42:3"
    "embedding_distance:43:2"
    "embedding_distance:44:2"
    "dataflow_aware:42:3"
    "dataflow_aware:43:2"
    "dataflow_aware:44:2"
)

mkdir -p "$LOG_BASE"

for run_spec in "${RUNS[@]}"; do
    IFS=':' read -r strategy seed epochs <<< "$run_spec"
    RUN_NAME="${strategy}_s${seed}"
    OUTPUT_DIR="${CHECKPOINT_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}"
    TRAIN_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
    VAL_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
    RUN_LOG="${LOG_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}.log"

    echo ""
    echo "── Training: ${RUN_NAME} (${epochs} epochs) ──"
    echo "  Output: $OUTPUT_DIR"
    echo "  Log: $RUN_LOG"

    mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$(dirname "$RUN_LOG")"

    EXTRA_ARGS=""
    if [ "$strategy" = "dataflow_aware" ] && [ -f "${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json" ]; then
        EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
    fi

    python -u "${PROJECT_ROOT}/training/train.py" \
        --model-name "$MODEL_PATH" \
        --train-file "$TRAIN_FILE" \
        --val-file "$VAL_FILE" \
        --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
        --hard-negative-strategy "$strategy" \
        --seed "$seed" \
        --batch-size 8 \
        --num-negatives 7 \
        --max-seq-length 2048 \
        --num-epochs "$epochs" \
        --learning-rate 2e-5 \
        --temperature 0.07 \
        --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
        --eval-steps 500 \
        --save-steps 1000 \
        --use-lora \
        --gradient-checkpointing \
        --wandb-project structfuse \
        --wandb-run-name "m2_full_sc2_${RUN_NAME}" \
        --early-stopping-patience 2 \
        $EXTRA_ARGS \
        2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"

    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${RUN_NAME}"

    if [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}/best" ]; then
        find "${OUTPUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " ALL 8 RESUME RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Only Phase 2 (training) for seeds 43, 44 — data already built
set -euo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

PROJECT_ROOT="/root/structfuse"
MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/bigcode/starcoder2-3b/bigcode/starcoder2-3b"
STARCODER_DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data"
CHECKPOINT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder"
LOG_BASE="/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder"

SEEDS=(43 44)
STRATEGIES=(random embedding_distance dataflow_aware)

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "============================================"
echo " StarCoder M2 Training (seeds 43,44)"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo " GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
echo "============================================"

for strategy in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
    for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
        RUN_NAME="${strategy}_s${seed}"
        OUTPUT_DIR="${CHECKPOINT_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}"
        TRAIN_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        VAL_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        RUN_LOG="${LOG_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}.log"

        echo ""
        echo "── Training: ${RUN_NAME} ──"
        echo "  Output: $OUTPUT_DIR"
        echo "  Log: $RUN_LOG"

        mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$(dirname "$RUN_LOG")"

        EXTRA_ARGS=""
        if [ "$strategy" = "dataflow_aware" ] && [ -f "${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json" ]; then
            EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
        fi

        python -u "${PROJECT_ROOT}/training/train.py" \
            --model-name "$MODEL_PATH" \
            --train-file "$TRAIN_FILE" \
            --val-file "$VAL_FILE" \
            --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
            --hard-negative-strategy "$strategy" \
            --seed "$seed" \
            --batch-size 8 \
            --num-negatives 7 \
            --max-seq-length 2048 \
            --num-epochs 2 \
            --learning-rate 2e-5 \
            --temperature 0.07 \
            --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
            --eval-steps 500 \
            --save-steps 1000 \
            --use-lora \
            --gradient-checkpointing \
            --wandb-project structfuse \
            --wandb-run-name "m2_full_sc2_${RUN_NAME}" \
            --early-stopping-patience 2 \
            $EXTRA_ARGS \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"

        echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${RUN_NAME}"

        if [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}/best" ]; then
            find "${OUTPUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    done
done

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " ALL 6 RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"
